svg.title: HeartGold decompilation source-language treemap
svg.desc: Rectangle area represents mapped code bytes. Green is C-only source, teal is C++-only source, lime is C with original inline asm, blue is original hand-written assembly, lilac is build-tool generated, grey is linker-style veneers, amber is mixed source and assembly, slate is assembly, purple is unresolved. Hover for file details.
